$Comment: Names EVERY world 'any' - the catch-all a fallback rule targets when it should apply
The bare * pattern is the least specific thing a selector can match on, so a rule aimed at
'any' loses to a rule aimed at a real world name, and loses to one aimed at a world's
GameplayConfig. That is what makes it usable as a baseline: write the general rule against
'any' and the exceptions against a narrower selector, and the exceptions win.
Because every world carries this name, do not use 'any' to mean 'the normal world' - that
is 'primary' (Zc_Primary.json), and it excludes instances. Using 'any' by mistake places
content in every dungeon and minigame instance too.
There is rarely a reason to edit this file. To add a broad name of your own, ship your own
file with its own filename and its own Names entry instead.
